description:
Use this when the user wants one clip on their posting calendar: "schedule this clip for Friday", "post this
to TikTok tonight". Saves a DRAFT for one platform; to post it, show the user the draft and, once they say yes,
update_draft with schedule=true. review_url opens it in RipClip.
Not for: several platforms or clips at once (plan_posts with clip_ids) or changing a draft (update_draft). Free.

account_id.description: Account id from list_social_accounts; only needed with several accounts on one platform

caption.description: Post text, up to 2,200 characters; empty = no caption yet

platform.description: tiktok, youtube, instagram, facebook, threads or bluesky; "Shorts", "Reels", "IG" also work

scheduled_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 time with offset, e.g. 2026-10-24T18:00:00-05:00; empty = unscheduled draft

name: draft_post
title: Draft a post
